methodologyNotes: Dataset covers 12 current power rack and squat rack models spanning entry-level to premium tiers, including four-post power racks, flat-foot racks, and one wall-mounted folding model. Primary sources are manufacturer product pages (repfitness.com, roguefitness.com, titan.fitness, prxperformance.com, forceusa.com, bellsofsteel.com, fringesport.com, sorinex.com); secondary sources are expert review pages (Garage Gym Lab, BarBend, Garage Gym Reviews). Prices are current published US retail / 'starting at' figures captured from manufacturer pages on 2026-06-19; for REP rack-builder products the priceUsd reflects the live builder 'Starting at' figure (which has risen above older review-era base prices). 'standard' hole_spacing means non-Westside uniform spacing; weight_capacity_lb reflects rackable capacity where the manufacturer distinguishes rackable from total. All accessedAt = 2026-06-19. Adversarially re-verified: every priceUsd and headline spec re-fetched from primary manufacturer pages where reachable, with secondary corroboration. No fabricated/non-existent models found; all 12 products verified to exist.
